hook.line: What if you could force AI to rank you number one? I just did it.
hook.visual: Selfie-angle talking head in a home office, white caption box 'FORCE AI TO RANK YOU NUMBER ONE IN DAYS' low in the frame, hand gesturing.

beats.what: Question plus claim that he already did it, with a boxed title.
Promises it took under 30 seconds and he will show how.
Credentials and a follow ask: he runs an SEO agency.
Cut to a phone shot of a laptop showing an article on Google's preferred source button.
Zoom punch on the add-button screenshots.
Laptop shot of his own site footer with the button added.
Typing 'best SEO company in Buffalo' into an AI chat.
Punch-in on the answer listing his agency first.
Shows the result text explaining why.
Back to camera: comment a keyword to get the free resource.

why_it_works: Result first ('I just did it'), so the viewer stays to see how.
Proof is filmed on a real laptop screen, not a slick recording, which reads as unstaged evidence.
Comment-a-keyword to receive the resource drove 1,797 comments, far above the other metrics' ratio.
A mid-video follow ask placed right after the credentials, before the payoff.
weaknesses: No captions after the opening title; silent viewers lose the steps.
Phone-filmed screens are tilted and partly cropped, so the key result text is hard to read.
for_robert: Use comment-a-keyword as his CTA: Fred could hold up the keyword on a sign at the end while Robert says 'comment X and I'll send it'.
